notes: Quantum error correction with the toric code on a neutral-atom platform. Demonstrates many cycles of syndrome extraction (up to 90 syndrome rounds) using mid-circuit measurement and replacement (reloading) of lost qubits, with logical information preserved through multiple reloading rounds. RELEVANCE 3/5: extends repeated-QEC-cycle capability on neutral atoms (the substrate family for our HYP-017 MERA approach). Continues the FT-neutral-atom trend; lowers FT cost trajectory but does not change physics anchors.
